decision: One source-supported upper plan in the existing river planning hub; three source/direction failures held with explicit old-path review explanations. Keep all four source records and legacy assets for correction.

distanceBoundary.review: Both complete brochure pages rendered and visually reviewed; trip text checked against the full map and mileage chart.

distanceBoundary.lakeFinish: American Realty Road crossing / Umsaskis Thoroughfare
distanceBoundary.qualification: Approximately fourteen miles combines the brochure's two descriptions. Carries and side exploration are additional. This is not a surveyed fourteen-mile track or a claim that the manager publishes the whole road-to-road plan as one nine-mile trip.

formerTakeOut.finding: A different downstream Allagash River access; not the named Umsaskis finish

accessBinding.limits: Published facility coordinates are not surveyed wet entries. The registry records area anchors and does not infer a water-entry coordinate. Confirm carries, parking, dam side and current access with the ranger.

formerPutIn.finding: Bissonette Bridge, as established by the named DACF KML; township alone did not identify Churchill Dam.

researchHolds.reason: Stored endpoint order runs upstream against the manager's explicit northward-flow description and full map. The inventory does not establish the eighteen-mile/full-day itinerary. Do not silently reverse it.

The claimed falls finish uses another T15 R11 access point upstream of the mapped falls portage. The brochure's three-mile stage does not establish that pin or a vehicle landing at the Falls. Verify the safe above-falls boundary and exit or continuation.
The claimed below-falls start uses the same upstream access point. Resolve the mandatory portage, safe post-portage entry and distinct Twin Brook/Village finish before offering this stage.

managerRules.review: Official pages read in the browser after the web extractor returned 403. Rules distinguish designated motor-vehicle access from portage trails and campsites.

sections.2.1: Overnight campsite parties register at the first opportunity.
sections.2.2: Authorized camping and location-specific exceptions; no general bank-camping permission inferred.
sections.2.8: Watercraft type/dimension restrictions; inflatable craft prohibited on this section.
sections.2.10: Churchill Dam and Umsaskis Launching Area in T11 R13 are designated motor-vehicle access locations; the list does not establish a vehicle landing at the Falls.
sections.2.15: Separate authorized falls and Churchill–Big Eddy portage trails.

managerRules.portageLimits: The brochure describes paid service around the most difficult Chase Rapids section. Current staffing and exact transport/carry limits must be arranged; no complete rapid bypass or fixed daily availability is promised.
managerRules.dateLimits: The visible May 20, 2026 bridge-project notice does not establish an October opening or closure. No reopening inference made.

geometry.source: Corrected named Maine DACF facility anchors; replacement route trace not published
geometry.review: The PR102 line began at Bissonette Bridge. Independent named KML review proved the start mismatch. Attempts to obtain the additional official USGS southern corridor returned 502/504 and timed out. Do not keep an incomplete trace or invent a connector.
geometry.publication: Access facilities only. Explicit hold in route-geometry-review-holds.js suppresses the line, straight fallback and GPX. The stable route asset is overwritten with geometry:null and a review reason; the route is excluded from mapped coverage and the state line bundle. Restore only after a complete source-supported corridor and dam/carry boundaries are reviewed.
geometry.legacy: Three held research-route assets and all unrelated route assets remain unchanged.

publication.rationale: The hub contains the complete corrected plan, gauge context, source-boundary explanation and research notices. A duplicate standalone guide for the sole public plan adds no separate intent. Three inaccurate records are held explicitly, not disguised as useful alternate trips.
publication.heldOldPaths: Exact #review-<old-slug> explanations in the same hub; not redirects to the usable upper trip.
publication.delivery: Existing HTTP 200 instant meta-refresh with hub canonical; not an HTTP 301. Held-path fallback text says access review. Held trip APIs/exports are unavailable; research records and legacy assets remain.
publication.guard: The single-plan hub is explicitly reviewed; unreviewed one-trip families do not gain hub pages.

preservation: The upper plan retains its trip and selected-access IDs, proxy USGS 01011000 and planning-only status. Add lake-wind exposure; no numeric flow cutoff. Preserve all original source URLs and the other 2,548 public trip records. Historic recovery winners and comparison families remain unchanged.
demand: No Allagash rows in the available baseline exports: unobserved demand, not verified zero demand. The original protected winners and comparison families do not include Allagash.
measurement: Source and publication improvements do not establish a Google quality demotion, causation or recovery. Verify merged publication on both serving paths and assess later confirmed Google observations.
status: Corrected named source binding; map-line/GPX hold permits accurate facility planning without waiting on a replacement trace. Deployment evidence recorded separately.
